body: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used to extract structured fields from business documents, yet most evaluations report accuracy on clean benchmarks and offer little guidance to practitioners choosing an approach for a given task complexity. We address this gap with a measurement-grounded study and an open-source release. Across eleven systems (three commercial, two reasoning, five open-source VLMs in pretrained and fine-tuned form, and a non-LLM OCR->regex floor) scored on a 750-document held-out pool of synthetic checks, fine-tuning on 3K samples lifts the best open-source VLMs above F1 0.98-above every zero-shot commercial system on this task-while GPT-5 leads the commercial pool on F1 and Claude Sonnet 4.5 collapses on Date. To turn these measurements into actionable choices, we introduce a practitioner-oriented selection framework that maps a task profile (quality, latency, governance, volume) to a recommended approach via filtering and total-cost minimization, illustrated on a hypothetical mid-volume document-extraction scenario.
summaryZh: 本文针对视觉语言模型（VLMs）在结构化商业文档提取中的应用，开展了基于真实测量的研究并开源相关代码与基准。通过对11个系统（涵盖商业模型、推理模型和开源VLM）在750份合成支票测试集上的评估发现，3K样本微调能使最佳开源VLM超越零样本商业系统。研究进一步提出了从质量、延迟和治理等维度帮助从业者选择模型的方法论与总成本最小化框架。
